newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin closes eight cents up at 14.70 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin closes eight cents up at 14.70 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price climbed eight cents to 14.70 ringgit ($5.83) a kg on strong Japanese buying after the London Metal Exchange (LME) rose overnight.
"There were many bids at the opening, especially by Japanese buyers, spurred by the higher LME," said a dealer. The LME closed $40 higher on Thursday.

Dealers reported initial bids of 140 tonnes against offers of 70. Final turnover was 130 tonnes against 162 on Thursday, and was absorbed by Japanese, European and local interests. The local premium against London rose to $50 a tonne from $30.
